findings.description: `total = sum(1 for _ in lines)` exhausts `lines` before the main loop runs. The CLI passes a file object, which is a one-shot iterator, so the `for line in lines` loop sees nothing. The run reports zero read, zero written, and produces an empty destination file with no error.
findings.suggestion: Materialise the input first (for example `lines = list(lines)`), or drop the total count and report progress without a denominator, or pass a re-iterable source.
findings.title: Counting lines consumes the input iterable before processing

findings.description: In the `except LookupTimeout` branch, `return enrich(event, geo)` returns the coroutine object rather than awaiting it. `_flush` then passes that coroutine to `sink`, where `to_json` fails or writes garbage. Any lookup that times out once crashes the run or corrupts the output.
findings.suggestion: Change the line to `return await enrich(event, geo)`.
findings.title: Retry returns an un-awaited coroutine instead of an Event
